runtime_actions.plugin_area: OLMDistanceGradation 16bpc case_0010 single-site compose witness, break-ignore retry
runtime_actions.command: Run the included launcher separately for field and source at (6,40). It must contain `sxi 80000003` so the first-chance break observed in the prior return cannot terminate the trace before the selected downstream site.
runtime_actions.stop_condition: Satisfactory: exact RDI==target_output stop with typed RCX field words or RDX source words. Partial: selected site is reached but the equality gate misses and both live RDI and target are logged. Failure: the run again ends at first-chance 80000003, no entry witness, multiple sites in one run, or no typed downstream evidence.
